generations.name: 2026 refresh (bZ)
generations.notes: Renamed bZ. New packs: 57.7 kWh LFP (XLE FWD) and 74.7 kWh (US figure; Toyota Canada quotes 77 kWh total); DC up to 150 kW, 10-80% in about 30 min; native NACS; 11 kW AC. Same name and year in CA and US. 74.7 (US) vs 77 kWh (CA) is probably usable vs total for one pack. The bZ Woodland (2026 US / 2027 CA on sale) is a separate wagon model, not part of this line. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toyota_bZ4X ; https://media.toyota.ca/en/releases/2025/toyota-bz-all-electric-suv-adds-range--charging-and-exterior-upd.html
